title: Check run
description: interlock's own execution of a criterion's check on one tree. Append-only. A run passes only when the command exited 0, did not time out, and did not run nothing.

attempt_id.description: The attempt that asked for the run; null for runs the operator or supervisor made.

producer.description: Who asked for the run, taken from the attempt's role.

target.description: output: the tree under verification. base: the task's input snapshot.

vacuous.description: Set when the output shows the check ran nothing, naming the detector that matched.

output_ref.description: Content-addressed artifact holding the full output.
